_credentials_comment: Copy .env.example to .env for Chaos, HackerOne, and Resin credentials. Keep secrets out of config.json.
_resin_comment: Optional Resin egress endpoint. Connection facts live here; RESIN_PROXY_TOKEN lives in .env. Mode (rotate/sticky) and Account are chosen per task — see docs/resin-proxy.md.
_cf_solver_comment: Evidence-triggered Cloudflare challenge clearance helper. /autopilot may invoke it after target-owned challenge evidence; set api_key in local config.json or TWOCAPTCHA_API_KEY; headful=true requires a desktop browser.
